shared_rules.quantity: One exact positive plan quantity in NewSaleQuery; never multiply selected item quantities again. Unsupported authored shapes remain blocked under Q-03.
shared_rules.selection: No-selection, selected NULL, and selected text default are three distinct diagnostic identities; native commercial selection is item UUID plus nullable dimension.
shared_rules.diagnostics: Registry pins producer/operation/profile/predicate/reason, applicability, expected cardinality/dependencies, Orders mapping and evidence allowlist. Unknown required profile/predicate refuses; raw message text never maps policy.
shared_rules.conjunction: Required unevaluable wins, otherwise failed wins, otherwise passed; retain all independently verified subresults in declared order.
shared_rules.preview: Only registry-approved missing term/cycle can withhold TCV, and missing forecast-only policy can withhold forecast. Required commercial uncertainty, malformed output or missing remaining money/tax still blocks.
shared_rules.digests: Reuse public Pricing helpers only for their declared domains. Preserve issued bytes. Proposed assessment/Rating canonical digests require producer agreement; no local JSON hash substitutes.
shared_rules.failure: Absence, business refusal, authorization denial, transient outage and malformed result are distinct internal categories; public mapping uses existing Orders reasons and disclosure rules.
shared_rules.limits: 200 lines, 200 consumed items/order, 1000 selected bindings/line before deduplication, 1 MiB entire immutable version. Provider-specific diagnostic field limits still require agreed profiles.
